[[File:Warhammer Quest The Adventure Card Game original logo.png|thumb|Original Warhammer Quest: The Adventure Card Game logo.]]
'''Warhammer Quest: The Adventure Card Game''' is a cooperative fantasy card game designed by Adam Sadler and Brady Sadler. Fantasy Flight Games released it on 26 November 2015 under license from Games Workshop.<ref name="rules">[https://cdn.1j1ju.com/medias/fc/2d/47-warhammer-quest-the-adventure-card-game-learn-to-play.pdf Warhammer Quest: The Adventure Card Game Learn to Play], Fantasy Flight Games, credits. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107195755/https://cdn.1j1ju.com/medias/fc/2d/47-warhammer-quest-the-adventure-card-game-learn-to-play.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref>[https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2015/11/26/choose-your-path/ Choose Your Path], Fantasy Flight Games, 26 November 2015. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250918023050/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2015/11/26/choose-your-path/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Gameplay ==

One to four players take on the roles of heroes who cooperate to complete quests and survive dungeon encounters. The rulebook provides a campaign and a separate delve quest.<ref name="rules" />

== Publication ==

The ''Witch Hunter'' and ''Troll Slayer'' hero packs followed the core game in 2016. Fantasy Flight Games announced that its Games Workshop product lines, including this game, would leave its catalog on 28 February 2017.<ref>[https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2016/6/16/witch-hunter-and-troll-slayer/ Witch Hunter and Troll Slayer], Fantasy Flight Games, 16 June 2016. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250915200011/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2016/6/16/witch-hunter-and-troll-slayer/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref>[https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2016/9/9/a-new-path-forward/ A New Path Forward], Fantasy Flight Games, 9 September 2016. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260604032756/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2016/9/9/a-new-path-forward/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Online play ==

The [[TCGMix]] playtest includes the tutorial, ''An Uneasy Alliance'' campaign and ''Lost in the Dark'' delve, with companion bots for empty seats.<ref name="catalog" />

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/whq/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-warhammer-quest-the-adventure-card-game">[https://tcgmix.com/whq/ Play Warhammer Quest: The Adventure Card Game], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107195309/https://tcgmix.com/whq/ Internet Archive].</ref>
